pro.basis: Windows: five_hour and seven_day. Claude Pro includes no Fable allowance, so there is no weekly_fable window. Capacity per window comes only from public community data (references/five-axis-scores.json); none is stated here.

max5.basis: Windows: five_hour, seven_day and weekly_fable (the Fable allowance is its own weekly window). Capacity per window comes only from public community data (references/five-axis-scores.json); none is stated here.

max20.basis: Windows: five_hour, seven_day and weekly_fable (the Fable allowance is its own weekly window). Capacity per window comes only from public community data (references/five-axis-scores.json); none is stated here.

max.basis: Plan tier not reported as 5x or 20x; the windows of the smaller Max 5x plan apply and the capacity stays unknown until public data names one.

plus.basis: Windows: the weekly usage window and, since 2026-08-25, a five_hour window. Capacity per window comes only from public community data (references/five-axis-scores.json); none is stated here.

team.basis: Team seats use the same per-seat allowance prior as Plus.

pro100.basis: Window: the weekly usage window. Capacity per window comes only from public community data (references/five-axis-scores.json); none is stated here.

pro.basis: Window: the weekly usage window. Capacity per window comes only from public community data (references/five-axis-scores.json); none is stated here.

ultra20.basis: Google AI Ultra 20x: a five-hour and a weekly window for the Gemini pool and for the independent third-party pool. Capacity per window comes only from public community data (references/five-axis-scores.json); none is stated here.

ultra5.basis: Google AI Ultra 5x: the windows of Ultra 20x. Capacity per window comes only from public community data (references/five-axis-scores.json); none is stated here.

pro.basis: Google AI Pro: the windows of Ultra 20x. Capacity per window comes only from public community data (references/five-axis-scores.json); none is stated here.

ultra.basis: Ultra tier not reported as 5x or 20x; the windows of Ultra 20x apply and the capacity stays unknown until public data names one.

default.basis: Used until the tier is known: the smallest paid tier, with a warning, never the largest. `agy -p /usage` returns only bucket fractions; discovery reads the tier from Google's loadCodeAssist with agy's own sign-in (scripts/antigravity_plan.py, cached in <state dir>/antigravity-plan.json, refreshed beside routing runs), so this prior covers a first run, an expired agy token or a failed read. A plan can also be named in the account document's `plan` (for example "Google AI Pro") or in `plan_templates`.

pro.basis: The ChatGPT web bridge is only ready when its config reports proAvailable, so a ready bridge is a Pro web seat. Pro consultations draw no API-priced quota (unmetered); the 5-per-12h cadence window is priced from current-period consultations used against the 5-seat capacity and remaining period time.

price_source.statement: The X Subscription Free: $0/month (does not include Grok Bot)

free.basis: Free Grok tier: no paid monthly subscription and no Grok Bot allowance. Live window IDs come from the usage collector when present.

plus.basis: The X Subscription Plus ($8/month). Live credits window IDs come from the usage collector when present; capacity follows the runtime price-matching rule.

price_source.statement: The X Subscription Premium: $30/month (includes Grok Bot and shared weekly usage pool)

premium.basis: The X Subscription Premium ($30/month). Live credits window IDs come from the usage collector; capacity follows the runtime price-matching rule.

price_source.statement: SuperGrok: $30/month individual subscription (unified with The X Subscription Premium at $30/month)

supergrok.basis: SuperGrok ($30/month; reported as SuperGrok on /v1/settings and GrokPro on /v1/user?include=subscription). Live credits window IDs come from the usage collector; capacity follows the runtime price-matching rule.

price_source.statement: The X Subscription Super: $100/month (includes Grok Bot and shared weekly usage pool)

super.basis: The X Subscription Super ($100/month). Live credits window IDs come from the usage collector; capacity follows the runtime price-matching rule.

price_source.statement: The X Subscription Ultra: $200/month (includes Grok Bot and shared weekly usage pool)

ultra.basis: The X Subscription Ultra ($200/month). Live credits window IDs come from the usage collector; capacity follows the runtime price-matching rule.
